description: 控制手机进入“打盹模式”（Doze 模式）的速度。
description_en: Controls how fast your phone enters doze mode
name: Doze Delay

description: 监控 CPU 温度并自动切换调频策略
description_en: Monitors CPU temp and switches governor automatically
name: Thermal Guard

description: 每次开机时清理临时文件和日志
description_en: Cleans temp files and logs at every boot
name: Boot Cleaner

description: 显示当前哪些应用正在大量消耗电量。只需轻轻一点，就能看到一份列出耗电大户的简洁清单。
description_en: Shows which apps are eating your battery right now. One tap and you get a simple list of the worst offenders.
name: Wakelock Hunter

description: 根据您当前连接的网络自动切换私有 DNS。连接 WiFi 时使用一种 DNS，使用移动数据时则使用另一种。您还可以针对特定的 WiFi 名称设置专属 DNS。
description_en: switches your private DNS based on what network you're on. WiFi gets one DNS, mobile data gets another. You can also set DNS per specific WiFi name
name: DNS Flip

description: 在夜间强制手机进入深度睡眠状态
description_en: Forces your phone into deep sleep at night
name: Deep Doze

description: 一键关闭后台用户应用。保持白名单应用运行。仅支持手动触发。
description_en: Kills background user apps with one tap. Keeps whitelisted apps alive. Manual trigger only
name: Quiet Kill

description: 定期清理 /data/adb/log 中的旧日志
name: log-rotator

description: 定期清理应用与系统缓存
description_en: Periodically clears app and system cache
name: cache-cleaner

description: 在指定的启动阶段执行自定义命令
description_en: Run custom commands at a chosen boot stage
name: boot-script
